summary: D-MARKET Electronic Services & Trading (d/b/a Hepsiburada, NASDAQ: HEPS) filed a Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 earnings press release, a routine foreign-private-issuer current report rather than a special situation. Results are restated under IAS 29 hyperinflation accounting for the Turkish lira: GMV fell 6.6% to TRY 62.0 billion and revenue declined 6.1% to TRY 24.3 billion, while unadjusted GMV rose 22.3%. Orders, active customers and order frequency grew modestly; marketplace share reached 69.8%. No transaction, board recommendation or advisor is disclosed; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
